task_disposition: CROSS OUT for the supervised benchmark suite based on the published split and rights gate. The 20-series Tuning list has two positive-prefix members and both are TAO, whose license is not listed. No explicitly licensed source contributes a positive training member in Tuning; the 180 Eva series are not training data in the published protocol, and there is no supervised validation split. Per-series architecture shape is compatible in principle; the maximum estimated input matrix plus five 512-unit hidden forward activations is 1.0702 GiB before gradient/optimizer/workspace costs. If source groups are pooled, GHL, MITDB and SVDB activation estimates exceed 3 GiB, with GHL above 6 GiB. No repo-MLP pilot establishes non-saturation.
memory_unit_note: Per-series estimates treat each CSV as one model task, use 128-sample windows over the filename-declared training prefix, float32 flattened inputs and five 512-unit hidden layers. They count the full input matrix plus five forward activation tensors only; backward/autograd, optimizer states, parameters and CUDA workspace are excluded. Source-group aggregate activation estimates assume pooling all member prefixes and are not per-series requirements.

repo_architecture_compatibility.architecture: src/simple_adp/models.py::TabularMLP accepts a configurable input_dim and any positive hidden-width vector; a univariate series window maps to 128 inputs, and multivariate width maps to 128 times the channel count.
repo_architecture_compatibility.task_adapter: src/simple_adp/advanced_tasks.py::SupervisedAnomalyTask is a binary classifier, but fit_targets rejects a training partition without both labels. A per-point binary label can be supervised as center/next-point window classification after a causal fixed-window transform.
repo_architecture_compatibility.runner_integration: No TSB-AD-U/M dataset provider or validated task configuration is registered in the repo.
repo_architecture_compatibility.split_safety: Use the filename-declared temporal training prefix only for training/validation, keep the suffix as chronological test, and exclude a window gap at the partition boundary; random overlapping-window splits leak adjacent samples.
